description: Binance ticker in the portfolio only for the same token (Android PortfolioPriceIdentity.kt / iOS PortfolioPriceIdentity.swift). binanceCheck(coin, knownName, binanceName, otherNames): with a known name (watchlist) USE unless the names clearly differ (SKIP); without a known name USE only when Binance names the symbol and it is not a known collision (TokenIdentity.KNOWN with more than one group: LUNA, LUNC, TON, GMT, HOT, CAT, NVDA), otherwise UNCHECKED (no Binance price; without another price the coin shows as unchecked). Without a known name, when Binance's name and the names of other stored pair lists (otherNames, one per exchange) clearly conflict (TokenIdentity.conflicting), UNVERIFIED = the Binance price is used but flagged 'price unverified' (row hint, portfolio alarms treat it like a stale price). binanceName maps symbol -> Binance fullName (missing = unknown); otherNames maps symbol -> names in other pair lists (missing = none). In the split, 'use' contains the UNVERIFIED coins as well.

checks.case: named match (other lists conflict, name wins)
named match on an ambiguous symbol
named mismatch on an ambiguous symbol
nameless + ambiguous symbol (Classic only on one list)
nameless + not in Binance's list (other lists conflict too)
